summary: Preserve silent/deviceName semantics using system-defined printer names rather than friendly display labels.

target.notes: Preserve Electron WebContents/Chromium renderer semantics through the ElectronCompat host boundary; do not replace navigation, rendering, printing, or DevTools with ordinary .NET calls.

semantics.deviceName: must identify system printer device name
semantics.failure: invalid/unavailable printer reported through print outcome

tests.name: silent
tests.expected_behavior: uses default printer without interactive settings when available

tests.name: device identifier
tests.expected_behavior: uses system-defined device identifier, not arbitrary friendly-name equivalence
